title: Fossils Revived
description: A JP/JW inspired resource pack for fossils and archeology that turns all canon creatures into their movie counter parts
body:
Fossils Revived a Fossils & Archaeology Resource Pack
Transform your Minecraft world into a thrilling Jurassic adventure with this resource pack! This pack takes the iconic creatures from the Fossils and Archeology mod and reimagines them in the style of Jurassic Park. Every dinosaur, from the mighty Tyrannosaurus Rex to the swift Velociraptor, has been given a makeover to reflect the classic, cinematic look of Jurassic Park.



Re-imagined textures and models for all canon creatures from the Fossils & Archaeology mod in the style of Jurassic Park.

Fully immersive experience with a Jurassic aesthetic for every dinosaur.

Compatible with both single-player and multiplayer modes.

A must-have for any Jurassic Park fan and Minecraft player.

Get ready to bring the roar of dinosaurs back to life with a classic touch!

(Ps extra variants are added with the resource pack so you will need to add the entity texture features mod for them but its not needed unless you want the extra skin variants)
